summary.one_liner: Lepton is a free, open-source Electron desktop app for managing code snippets stored as GitHub Gists and GitLab personal snippets.
summary.what_it_does: Lepton is a desktop snippet manager that syncs with GitHub Gist (including GitHub Enterprise) and GitLab personal snippets (GitLab.com or self-managed, via personal access token). It supports public and secret snippets, unlimited tags, language groups, and Markdown and Jupyter Notebook rendering. Users can search snippets, use a dashboard and an immersive editing mode, and set a proxy. Behavior is customized through a .leptonrc file with a choice of built-in themes and interface locales. Keyboard shortcuts cover creating, editing, deleting, syncing, and searching snippets.
use_cases: store snippets in GitLab personal snippets
keep Jupyter notebooks and Markdown notes with code
search and tag a personal snippet library
notable: Works with both GitHub Gist and GitLab personal snippets, including self-managed GitLab and GitHub Enterprise
Jupyter Notebook and Markdown rendering for snippets
Customizable via .leptonrc with many built-in themes and interface locales
Installable via Homebrew on macOS and Snap on Linux
Electron smoke and packaged smoke tests in CI
caveats: Real GitHub login requires registering your own OAuth app and adding client id and secret to configs/account.js; otherwise only a dummy config is used
Building the Linux snap package requires a running Docker daemon
Smoke test jobs are described as non-blocking CI checks while cross-platform validation matures
